versions.changelog:
- Added explicit note that browser login is now available in CLI 2.0.0 within the macOS arm64 preview scope.
- Updated authentication documentation to reference the [browser login preview scope](https://github.com/nansen-ai/nansen-cli/blob/main/docs/browser-login.md#preview-platform-scope).
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

- Adds support for browser session authentication using `nansen:api` in addition to API keys.
- Updates authentication section to clarify precedence, credential handling, and account/endpoint checks.
- Removes direct mention of internal-only API usage; clarifies endpoint behavior for both authentication methods.
- Minor documentation consistency improvements and clarifies credential selection, caching, and fallback behavior.
- Removes obsolete file: skill-card.md.

- Added support for sending alerts to custom webhooks via --webhook and --webhook-secret flags.
- Updated documentation to describe webhook usage and integration possibilities (server, Zapier, n8n, custom endpoints).
- Clarified that multiple notification channels can be combined (e.g., Telegram, Slack, Webhook).
- Improved option tables to include new flags.

Initial release with smart alert management features:

- Create, list, update, toggle, and delete smart alerts via CLI.
- Supports alert types: Smart Money Token Flows, Common Token Transfer, Smart Contract Call.
- Rich flag and filtering options for each alert type.
- Multiple notification channels: Telegram, Slack, Discord.
- Internal-only: requires Nansen internal API key.
